title: Integer overflow or wraparound in Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based) allows an unauthorized attacker to… (CVE-2026-88077)
description: CVE-2026-88077 is an integer overflow or wraparound vulnerability in Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based) that allows an unauthorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network. The vulnerability has a high severity with a CVSS score of 8.8, indicating significant impact on confidentiality, integrity, and availability. No affected versions or patch information are provided in the available data.
